name: DeepSeek TUI
description: A terminal-native coding agent built around DeepSeek V4's 1M-token context and prefix cache. Features native RLM (Recursive Language Model) for parallel reasoning, thinking-mode streaming, full tool suite (file ops, shell, git, web search), three interaction modes (Plan/Agent/YOLO), session save/resume, workspace rollback, and MCP protocol support. Ships as a single binary with no Node/Python runtime required.
community_quotes: Coding agent for DeepSeek models that runs in your terminal
Built for DeepSeek V4 with 1M-token context windows and native thinking-mode streaming
Single binary, no Node/Python runtime required

name: Ruflo
description: Multi-agent AI orchestration platform for Claude Code that coordinates 100+ specialized agents across machines and trust boundaries. Features self-learning swarm intelligence, HNSW-indexed vector memory (AgentDB), zero-trust federation for cross-machine agent collaboration, 32 Claude Code plugins, web UI at flo.ruv.io, and GOAP goal planner at goal.ruv.io. Agents self-organize, learn from tasks, and remember across sessions.
community_quotes: The leading agent orchestration platform for Claude
Orchestrate 100+ specialized AI agents across machines, teams, and trust boundaries
Features enterprise-grade architecture, self-learning swarm intelligence, RAG integration

name: n8n-mcp
description: A Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that gives AI assistants comprehensive access to n8n's workflow automation platform. Provides structured access to 1,650+ n8n nodes (820 core + 830 community), node properties, operations, and documentation. Enables Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, and other AI IDEs to build, validate, and deploy n8n workflows with 99% property coverage and 2,352 searchable templates.
community_quotes: A bridge between n8n's workflow automation platform and AI models
Supports 1,650 n8n nodes with 99% property coverage
Works with Claude Code, VS Code, Cursor, Windsurf, and Codex

name: jcode
description: A next-generation coding agent harness built for multi-session workflows with infinite customizability. Features semantic memory embeddings for project-long recall, swarm collaboration across multiple agents, browser automation via Firefox Agent Bridge, and exceptional performance (14ms to first frame, 167MB RAM). Supports OAuth providers (Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, Copilot, etc.) and self-dev mode where agents modify their own source code.
community_quotes: Built for multi-session workflows, infinite customizability, and performance
6.0× more RAM efficient than alternatives in active sessions
Swarm mode enables native collaboration between multiple agents with conflict resolution
